# Corporate Code Guidelines & Lint Rules

## Overview
This document outlines standard coding practices for all AI workers in ZenBudget.

### Core Architecture Rules:
1. **Never guess API parameters**: Always inspect exact schemas before calling DB or LLM APIs.
2. **Strict Flow Control**: Enforce clean try/catch blocks with user-friendly diagnostics.
3. **No Superficial Symptom Patches**: When an exception occurs, resolve the root cause.

### Frontend Standards:
- Use HSL tailored color variables.
- Maintain glassmorphism design aesthetic across dark interfaces.

title: Agent Memory Engine Design Requirements
content:
# Agent Memory Engine Design Requirements

## Memory Architecture
The memory engine provides short-term and long-term context recall for AI executives.

### Memory Layers:
- **Short-Term Memory**: Stores recent 5 task execution logs and strategy tickets.
- **Long-Term Memory**: Vector embeddings stored in Supabase PostgreSQL tables.
- **Brand Guide Knowledge**: Accessible to CEO and CTO for strategic alignment.

Supabase Environment Setup Walkthrough
content:
# Supabase Environment Setup Walkthrough

## Setup Instructions
1. Configure `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` in `.env`.
2. Apply migrations with Prisma ORM: `npx prisma db push`.
3. Verify connection with `npx prisma studio`.

title: ZenBudget - Best Expense Tracker & Daily Budget Planner App Specification
content:
# ZenBudget Live Brand Intelligence & Feature Specification

## Official Live Site:
https://zenbudget-tracker.vercel.app/

## Tagline:
"Track Every Rupee, Save Every Month — Best Expense Tracker & Daily Budget Planner App"

## Brand Palette:
- **Theme Color**: `#22c55e` (Emerald Green)
- **Background**: `#0a0f1e` (Deep Dark Slate)
- **Text Color**: `#f0fdf4` / White

## Target Audience:
Gen Z, Couples, Young Professionals, and Families in India & Worldwide.

## Key Features & Value Propositions:
1. **Daily Smart Spending Limit**: Real-time warnings whenever spending exceeds daily targets, helping users save up to 30% more.
2. **AI Money Coach Guidance**: Personal AI assistant guiding budget allocations and wealth building.
3. **Impulse Purchase Blocker (48-Hour Pause)**: Blocks impulsive spending by enforcing a 48-hour cool-off period.
4. **Shared Couples Budgeting**: Real-time linked accounts for couples and families to track group expenses.
5. **Weekly Money Wrapped**: Spotify-style animated story summarizing weekly savings and habits.
6. **Multi-Currency & Multi-Language Support**: Complete Kharcha Tracker / Hisab Kitab support for Indian & Global users.
